params.body: `control` main no longer carries the Odoo adapter: Bextrust's gateway dropped what it does not use. The adapter stays on `control`'s `acme-demo` branch, and the handover now points there. A new section 9 lists what changed since 23 October, including what the records say if the sealed hosts are switched off to save costs (SOFTWARE instead of TDX).
params.title: HANDOVER: what changed since 23 October
